verdict: Profit rose as loan interest grew, fee income hit records in capital markets and treasury management, and credit costs stayed low.

kpis.label: Net interest margin
kpis.note: What the bank earns on its loans and assets after funding costs, up 2 bps from Q2

kpis.label: Common equity Tier 1 ratio
kpis.note: A key safety buffer of capital against risk (estimated)

segments.name: Net interest income
segments.note: Interest earned on loans minus interest paid on deposits and other funding.

segments.name: Noninterest revenue
segments.note: Fees and other non-interest money: service charges, card fees, wealth management, capital markets and mortgage income.

opex.name: Salaries and employee benefits
opex.note: Pay and benefits for staff — the bank's biggest running cost.

opex.name: Equipment, software and occupancy
opex.note: Technology, software and the cost of branches and offices ($113M + $74M).

opex.name: Other noninterest expense
opex.note: Everything else it costs to run the bank: outside services, marketing, professional and legal costs, card costs, FDIC insurance and miscellaneous expenses.

takeaways.title: Revenue grew 3% to $1.97B
takeaways.text: Revenue rose $57M from a year earlier to $1.97B, with net interest income up 3% to $1.30B and fee income up 2% to $675M.

takeaways.title: Credit costs stayed contained
takeaways.text: The bank set aside $68M for possible loan losses, down from $105M a year earlier, and net charge-offs fell to 0.29% of average loans.

takeaways.title: Net income was $631M
takeaways.text: Net income was $631M. After $20M of preferred dividends (dividends on a special class of shares), $611M, or $0.71 per share, was available to common shareholders.

oneTimers: Reported noninterest revenue includes $15M of securities losses from repositioning trades (selling investments at a loss to reinvest); the company's adjusted revenue of $1,988M excludes them.
footerNote: Bank adaptation, following the site's bank pages: segments are net interest income and noninterest revenue; cost of revenue is the provision for credit losses ($68M, money set aside for loans that may not be repaid); operating income is income before income taxes ($787M). Net income of $631M is total net income; $611M was available to common shareholders after $20M of preferred stock dividends.
